module: Flowgraph node "Race Pathnode Reached" (category logic, tag scenario). Lets flow through when a vehicle reaches a pathnode of the race (events.pathnodeReached). Fixed outputs: flow and nodeName (name of the reached pathnode). The modder can add string or number output pins: their value is read from the pathnode's customFields (same name and same type).
notes: When no pathnode is reached, flow is false and nodeName and the custom pins are nil.
work() indexes race.states[vehId] without a check: a vehicle absent from the race causes an error.

init.desc: Enables allowCustomOutPins and savePins, data.detailed = false.

work.desc: Reads the vehicle's events and fills flow, nodeName and the custom pins.
